kjv: Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul
mine: Abner was strengthening his own position in the house of Saul
note: Hebrew hayah mitchazzeq bebeyt sha'ul (reflexive, with "in") suggests Abner was building his own power within Saul's house, which sets up the concubine charge in 3:7; the KJV makes it simple loyal support.

kjv: [Am] I a dog's head, which against Judah do shew kindness
mine: Am I a dog's head belonging to Judah? Today I keep showing loyalty
note: Hebrew ha-rosh kelev anokhi asher lihudah: "that is Judah's" most naturally qualifies "dog's head" (am I a Judahite cur?); the KJV turns it into "against Judah" and joins it to the next clause.

kjv: smote him there under the fifth [rib]
note: Hebrew hachomesh means the belly or abdomen; "fifth rib" came from a false link with chamesh "five".

kjv: one that leaneth on a staff
note: Hebrew machaziq bappelekh: pelekh is a spindle, a woman's tool, so the curse wishes effeminate or unwarlike men on Joab's house; "staff" turns it into a curse of lameness or old age.

kjv: to cause David to eat meat
mine: to urge David to eat food
note: Hebrew lehavrot lechem means to give him food (lechem "bread, food"); "meat" in 1611 meant food in general.
